objections.raw_quote: I mean, I think this all started because I asked Trevor, like, just what is the program cost? And he was like, he wants to do a full orientation. Maybe we just start there. Like, what does the program cost?
objections.rep_response: Complied. Gave a short summary of what he had heard back, then quoted a range: 'at least in the four figures, usually around like 2,000 to 6,000 USD for six months, more so to the upper end of that scale.'

objections.raw_quote: So you're saying 6,000 for six months, it's $1,000 a month to basically get access to Trevor. Yeah, that's more than I'm, like, totally transparently.
objections.rep_response: Agreed immediately and did not attempt to isolate, reframe or defend the price. Within a minute he had pivoted to Primal University at $200 a month.

objections.raw_quote: I mean, may not be the right fit. I mean, he's sort of now, I imagine, you know, you get a lot of inquiries. And he's now got a very public persona, so that's great for him that he's able to monetize in that way, but I think I'm probably not the right...
objections.rep_response: Accepted the self-disqualification and agreed with it — 'exactly' — then offered the cheaper tier, framing the early disclosure as respecting his time.

objections.raw_quote: Can you send, can I try it out for like, I don't know, a month or two weeks or something like that? And then if it works out, I'll sign up.
objections.rep_response: Explained there is no trial as such but that a month can be bought and cancelled, then asked when he would decide and accepted a one-week timeline.

outcome.next_step: Rep to send details of Primal University; prospect to decide within about a week, with the option of a single month at $200 or $1,000 for six months.

notable.note: This is the closest fit to the stated ICP in the entire batch — a 40-year-old tech investor in the best shape of his life, explicitly wanting good-to-great — and he was off the core offer inside thirty seconds of hearing the price, with no attempt made to hold it. It is also the fourth different price structure this rep has quoted in four days: the six-month programme was described as a range from $2,000 to $6,000, and Primal University was offered at both $200 a month and $1,000 for six months. Clinically, he disclosed a torn left shoulder with surgery deferred and was routed to the tier with no coach supervision, with no question asked about what he has been told he can and cannot do.
